3. LEGAL FRAMEWORK FOR COMPENSATION

Apparent relevant sections from two (2) applicable pieces of legislation are extracted and

provided below. Additional research is to be conducted to determine if applicale amendments

exists and apply.

3.1. Compensation Laws

Legislation in Grenada that govern compensation to individuals for assets forgone or acquired

compulsorily for public purposes including for resettlement are contained principally in the

Grenada CONSTITUTION ORDER 1973 and the LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CAP 159) of

1945 (including the Land Acquisition Amendment Act 16 of 1991). Other relevant legislation
